newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar ends firmer in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar ends firmer in thin trading.

text.p: The Canadian dollar ended firmer at C$1.3980 (US$0.7153) on Tuesday from Monday's close of C$1.4001 (US$0.7142) after strengthening in concert with Canadian bonds and equities, dealers said.

They said Canadian financial markets strengthened after a report showed that U.S. durable goods orders fell more than expected in March, while the U.S. employment cost index for the first quarter rose less than expected.
The reports prompted speculation that the U.S. Federal Reserve will be less eager to raise rates at the next Federal Open Market Committee meeting starting May 20.
